front: Sustain the spell to perform minor magical tricks: cook, lift, make, or tidy small things. It can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions.
back:
Each time you Sustain, pick one:
Cook: cool, warm, or flavor 1 lb of nonliving material.
Lift: slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
Make: create a temporary crude, extremely fragile object of negligible Bulk; can't be a tool, weapon, or spell focus/cost.
Tidy: color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less; 1 Bulk takes 10 rounds, larger takes 1 minute per Bulk.
Changes beyond these last only while Sustained.
